summary_claims.claim: Five cross-sectoral principles issued on a non-statutory basis, with a statutory duty on regulators anticipated later (white paper p. 12).
Central functions including horizon scanning and risk monitoring (p. 45); section 3.3.3 on foundation models.

note: GOV.UK page and PDF confirm CP 815, 29 Mar 2023, last updated 3 Aug 2023 (Annex C correction slip of 4 Jul 2023). The title is the document's own title; the GOV.UK page title differs in word order, and either is official. The page is marked as published under the previous government but carries no withdrawal; the 2024 response is the related record GB-04. No official newer edition found.
